provenance_note: The uploaded reviewed file originally declared CLAUDE-OPUS-5 for all 60 rows. The row-level reviewer_id column was removed by explicit project-owner request; provenance is retained here so the labels are not misrepresented as independent human validation.
permitted_use: diagnostic challenge review and failure-mode analysis
not_permitted_as: independent human validation or externally validated accuracy evidence
sampling_frame_note: Frozen and no longer reproducible. Two of its three strata (HIGH_SIMILARITY_STRUCTURAL_NEGATIVE, BUYER_DECLARED_RESOLVED) were drawn from the France-level benchmark, and the sampler that drew them was removed with it on 2026-08-15. The PRIMARY_ACCEPTED stratum was drawn from production accepted links and is independent of that benchmark. The completed labels are retained rather than discarded because that stratum carries the accepted-link precision diagnostic.
active_evidence_scope: Only the PRIMARY_ACCEPTED stratum is quoted as active evidence. The challenge strata remain a failure-mode diagnostic tied to the retired sampling frame.
